title: CreditApplicationSubmitRequest
description: Submit one consented vehicle credit application through MCP, A2A or PAP. Each applicant carries their own credit consent, including the kind of inquiry they authorized. application_type joint requires a co_applicant with a relationship. Every monetary amount uses currency (USD when omitted). The request carries sensitive personal data: send it only to the dealer endpoint selected from verified discovery, and never repeat it in URLs, logs or free text.

application_type.description: individual: one applicant. joint: applicant and co_applicant apply together.

co_applicant.description: Second applicant of a joint application, with their own consent and a relationship. Required iff application_type is joint.

currency.description: Currency of every monetary amount in this application: income, housing payment, down payment, requested amount and payoff. Omitted means USD.

financing.description: Optional description of the financing the applicant wants.

down_payment.description: Cash down payment in whole currency units.

requested_amount.description: Amount the applicant wants to finance, in whole currency units.

vehicle_of_interest.description: Optional vehicle the applicant wants to finance. When condition is set it MUST be new, used or cpo.

payoff_amount.description: Remaining loan balance on the trade-in, in whole currency units.

lienholder.description: Lender holding the lien on the trade-in.

trade_in.description: Optional trade-in for this deal, with its loan payoff. When condition is present, use excellent, good, fair or poor.

message.description: Optional free-text note. Never place identifiers, account numbers or other sensitive data here.

submitted_at.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp at which the buyer agent finalized this submission.

idempotency_key.description: Required client-generated key (UUID recommended) for this credit application. Preserve the key and payload after a timeout or session renewal. Deduplicate for at least 24 hours by dealer and verified caller, including the stable PAP User ID where applicable; anonymous calls use dealer and key. The same caller and key across bindings return the complete original result with data.replayed true; a changed payload returns IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. A replay creates no new record, valuation or delivery.

allOf.description: relationship belongs to the co-applicant only
vehicle_of_interest.condition (when set) must be in the sale-condition vocabulary
trade_in.condition (when set) must be in the wear-condition vocabulary
